title: Attestation Verification - Buffer Fix
body:
Fixes #9199

Currently lines are read using scanner, however for very large attestations the buffer can be exceeded.

Golang documentation states;

> Programs that need more control over error handling or large tokens, or must run sequential scans on a reader, should use [bufio.Reader](https://pkg.go.dev/bufio#Reader) instead.

I encountered this error while running verification for a set of attestations:

> Error: bundles could not be loaded from JSON lines file: bufio.Scanner: token too long

This changes uses bufio reader and readlines instead to avoid buffer limits. An alternative would be to set a larger buffer, but the exact size would be dependent upon the size of a possible maximum attestation (which can be quite large).

This will resolve issue #9199
commit_messages: swap scanner to readline for attestations

issues.title: Attestation Verification Buffer Size
issues.body:
### Describe the bug

Attestations that are too large will throw the following error during verification.

> Error: bundles could not be loaded from JSON lines file: bufio.Scanner: token too long


### Steps to reproduce the behavior

`gh attestation verify oci://ghcr.io/forrin/in-toto-workflows:15f5ca8c47ad7ffca1d7cc7e9996c57010b024e7 -o Forrin --bundle sha256:05efdf15a77731613ea7f9267c2f0ca4543d8d5763f22d90f994bb5f52a48368.jsonl
`
### Expected vs actual behavior

Expected to pass verification. Actual is an error due to bufio scanner buffer limits.

### Logs

```
Loaded digest sha256:05efdf15a77731613ea7f9267c2f0ca4543d8d5763f22d90f994bb5f52a48368 for oci://ghcr.io/forrin/in-toto-workflows:15f5ca8c47ad7ffca1d7cc7e9996c57010b024e7
✗ Loading attestations from oci://ghcr.io/forrin/in-toto-workflows:15f5ca8c47ad7ffca1d7cc7e9996c57010b024e7 failed

Error: bundles could not be loaded from JSON lines file: bufio.Scanner: token too long
```

evidence.body:
```suggestion
	line, err = reader.ReadBytes('\n')
```

From the docs on https://pkg.go.dev/bufio#Reader.ReadLine:

>  Most callers should use [Reader.ReadBytes](https://pkg.go.dev/bufio#Reader.ReadBytes)('\n')
